changelog: Update Recommended Version
The issue of other players seeing previews of ped's has been fixed.
The problem of stillbirth during ped change has been resolved.
The entire ped list has been updated. All known peds have been added to peds.lua.
You will now be able to see how many peds are in the category on the main menu.
The Weebhook system has been moved to config_server.lua to prevent dumps. Please apply this important update.
Remove the old webhook code from config.lua
The spam bug in the reload function when using Ped has been fixed.
A progress bar was added when reloading.
The issue of displaying 'name by name' in ped requests has been fixed. It will now display 'first name last name'.
Players whose ped requests have been approved by the admin will now be able to access their ped request instantly in their menu.
All text in HTML and JS has been moved to Config.Locale
Improvements have been made to the style.css file for all screens.
Reloading now works on every ped model. Press R to reload; a new revolver-cylinder progress UI with a countdown is shown while reloading.
All visual bugs during reload (broken arms / stuck poses) are completely fixed. No reload animation is forced on the ped anymore.
Reload spam can no longer get you stuck, and reloading is blocked while aiming (same rule as the frameworks).

Weapon-type based reload sounds added (revolver, pistol, shotgun, sawed-off, repeater, rifle, sniper). Sounds are simple files in the new sounds/ folder and can be replaced by server owners - see SETUP.md.
New on-screen hints while playing as a ped: a red 'R - RELOAD' hint when your clip is empty, and an 'OUT OF AMMO' warning when your ammo is gone. Both can be turned off in config.

Full VORP and RSG-Core compatibility for reload and ammo. Ammo is always taken from and synced with your framework (VORP gunbelt / RSG ammo) - no free ammo, no ammo loss, and no other resource needs to be edited.
Restarting fx-pedmenu no longer freezes or bugs your character. If you are transformed into a ped, your ped and outfit are restored automatically after the restart (can be turned off in config).
New config options: ReloadTime, ReloadUI, ReloadSound, ReloadSoundVolume, ReloadPrompt, NoAmmoPrompt, RestorePedAfterRestart, WeaponReloadSounds.
Removed: the old spinning reload icon and the old reload behavior that played animations on the ped.
updateFiles: config.lua / new reload settings + new Config.Locale keys (reloading, reload_prompt, no_ammo)

changelog: Fixed the infinite ammo bug while playing as a ped (VORP + RSG). Reloading now always consumes your ammo and stays perfectly in sync with your inventory - no free ammo, no ammo loss.
The ammo belt limit is now enforced while playing as a ped: using ammo items can no longer stack your reserve past the limit your framework allows.
The reload hint now shows your remaining reserve ammo, e.g. 'R - RELOAD (12)'.
VORP: reloads are now reported to vorp_inventory through its own official event. More reliable syncing and no more 'possible cheat' warnings in the server console.

VORP: INSTALL-VORP.md has been completely rewritten with a much simpler, version-independent setup. IMPORTANT: if you applied the old integration steps, restore your original vorp_character files and follow the new steps.
While playing as a ped, firearms can now only be fired while aiming on every framework - no more hip fire / hammer-cock shots (can be turned off with Config.BlockHipFire).
The 'you cannot reload while aiming' message no longer pops up while playing as a ped on VORP.

New failed-reload feedback: if your weapon leaves your hand mid-reload (climbing, holstering, switching weapons), the cylinder UI cracks apart in red with a fail sound - and no ammo is spent. The sound is sounds/reload_fail.mp3 and can be replaced.
New config options: BlockHipFire, ReloadDebug. New Config.Locale key: reload_failed.
updateFiles: config.lua / new options (BlockHipFire, ReloadDebug) + new Config.Locale key (reload_failed)

changelog: Bow and arrow now work correctly while playing as a ped. Your arrows are no longer reduced to 1 - if you had 30 arrows, you still have 30 after transforming.
The bow is now completely excluded from the ped reload system. It behaves exactly the same as on your normal character, just like vanilla RDR2 / your framework intended.
Your bow and its arrows are now saved before transforming into a ped and restored right after, so you no longer have to reload it from your inventory every time.
Fixed: the left-click fire block could stay active after switching back to your normal character. It now only ever applies while you are actually playing as a ped.
Dual wielding now works properly. Both guns reload, even when you are carrying two of the same weapon.
Tap R to reload one hand, or hold R to reload both. If you let go before it finishes, nothing is loaded.
New reload hints appear under your ammo counters in the top right, showing how much ammo each gun has left.
Knives, the fishing rod, lasso, lantern and binoculars no longer say 'out of ammo' while you are a ped.
Your ammo is now always counted correctly. Nothing is lost or duplicated when you switch peds, die, use an ammo item, or turn back into your own character.
Your ammo is no longer lost if you crash or disconnect while playing as a ped - you get it back the next time you join.
Switching weapons no longer empties the gun you switch to.
Fixed your character freezing with both arms stuck out while dual wielding.
Fixed reloads that looked like they worked but did not actually load any ammo.
Fixed the last bullet in your second gun being unusable.
Pressing R to pick something up no longer reloads your gun at the same time.
New config: every ped restriction is now a simple on/off setting, and you can give individual peds their own rules.
The version checker no longer fills the console every time the server starts.
The script runs lighter than before.
updateFiles: config.lua (Please check the updates section on our Discord channel for details.)
